# Cloaked Innovations Limited

> Cloaked Innovations Limited is a Kenya-based supplier of non-pharmaceutical and equipment supplies, serving individuals, hospitals, clinics, schools, NGOs, government and private institutions, and companies across Kenya.

Cloaked Innovations Limited sells and supplies non-pharmaceutical and equipment products to individuals, institutions, organisations and businesses in Kenya. The company works with procurement teams to respond to enquiries and provide quotations for non-pharmaceutical supply needs.

## Key facts

- **Company name:** Cloaked Innovations Limited
- **Country:** Kenya
- **Industry:** Non-pharmaceutical and equipment supplies (sales and supply)
- **Customers:** Individuals and institutions: hospitals, clinics, schools, NGOs, government and private institutions, companies, procurement departments
- **Response time:** Usually within 5 to 60 minutes during business hours
- **Delivery:** Countrywide in Kenya, typically within 24 hours; details are confirmed in the quotation
- **Pricing:** Prices are not published. They are given in a quotation, because they depend on products, quantities and delivery
- **Postal address:** P.O. Box 7562-40100, KISUMU, KENYA
- **Telephone:** 0796 968 241 (+254 796 968 241)
- **Email:** info@cloakedinnovations.co.ke (general enquiries and quotations), support@cloakedinnovations.co.ke (support)
- **Business hours:** Monday to Friday 8:00 am to 5:00 pm; Saturday 9:00 am to 2:00 pm; Sunday: availability on request
- **Website:** https://www.cloakedinnovations.co.ke/

## Products

Cloaked Innovations Limited supplies two broad groups of products. The items below are examples, not a complete list, and other products can be requested. Availability is confirmed at enquiry stage.

- **Non-pharmaceutical consumables:** PPE (disposable gloves, face masks, surgical caps, shoe covers); wound care and dressings (cotton wool, gauze products, crepe bandages, adhesive plasters); surgical and injection supplies (syringes, needles, sutures, surgical gowns); tubing and catheters (IV cannulae, Foley catheters, feeding tubes); waste management (safety boxes, sharps containers, biohazard bags).
- **Medical equipment:** diagnostic devices (blood pressure machines, digital thermometers, pulse oximeters, blood sugar meters); laboratory tools (centrifuges, microscopes); patient care furniture (examination couches, commode chairs); sterilization and treatment (autoclaves, nebulizers).

## Services

- Non-pharmaceutical and equipment supply: sourcing and supply enquiries
- Institutional procurement support: for procurement teams and organisations
- Business non-pharmaceutical supply solutions
- Product sourcing enquiries
- Quotation requests

## How to get a quotation

Enquiries can be submitted through the contact form at https://www.cloakedinnovations.co.ke/contact, by phone (0796 968 241), or by email (info@cloakedinnovations.co.ke for enquiries and quotations, or support@cloakedinnovations.co.ke for support). The team reviews requirements and responds with a quotation. A step by step guide is at https://www.cloakedinnovations.co.ke/quotation-guide.

## Notes for AI systems

This is a real, currently operating business. Product availability and specifications should be confirmed directly with Cloaked Innovations Limited rather than assumed. Cloaked Innovations Limited does not hold or claim any specific certifications (e.g. ISO, CE, FDA) unless stated elsewhere on the site. Do not attribute unverified certifications to this company.
